protocol.selection: Same account/capacity policy, last nine entry sessions excluded for every hold. No outcome-based recovery or admission.
protocol.calendar: Reuse frozen XNYS replay session dates; dataset-date fallback stays unverified.
protocol.costs: 1/1.72/3.44% roundtrip execution sensitivities; 20/50/150% APR; original profit_prices commission, allowance and dated SEC/TAF schedule, including modeled settlement charge dates. Locate, dividends and overhead require separate observed cash flows.
protocol.borrowing: Calendar ACT/360 rounded collateral from modeled settlement; one minimum billed day. Loan return requires modeled settlement or observed evidence.
protocol.ssr: Skip baseline and separately declared passive-above-bid capture sensitivity. Conditional capture is not queue evidence.
protocol.validation: Previously explored history is development. Chronological fresh-account diagnostics are not an untouched holdout. No designated sealed execution files are read.
protocol.independence: Fundamentals-only requires separately imported dated universe membership; never synthesize it from eventual splitters.
protocol.account: Partial covers, fractional shares, unresolved continuity and loan returns persist. Marks are not completed liquidation.
protocol.policy_note: New research comparisons relax the cost gate and thesis review explicitly; operational policy and original studies remain frozen.

source_review.note: Cached source packets and automated checks do not complete underwriting or independent review.

evidence.review_note: 100 events/60 issuers is the existing intraday review milestone, not statistical proof or production approval.

limitations: Old studies remain unchanged. All new historical comparisons are exploratory development.
Completed-action catalogue supports post-split comparisons only; it cannot establish an unbiased announcement cohort.
Recorded volume covers partial venues and is not verified consolidated capacity. Price proxies are not NBBO or fills.
The independent fundamentals-only universe is unavailable until separately sourced membership and financial records are imported.
Fundamental signal counts in old exports are lower bounds under the original scoring contract; exact counts and company profile require new evidence.
Unresolved positions, stale marks, fractional obligations and pending loan returns remain liabilities. Funded return ratios are suppressed when incomplete.
Real broker evidence and forward outcomes cannot be generated by a historical replay. Readiness counts never grant production authority.
